# The Draw Specialists

## The Draw Specialists

Some teams seem allergic to winning _and_ losing — they just draw. This notebook
measures **draw rates** across **301,353 finished matches**: who draws most
overall, who draws most when cast as the underdog, and whether teams draw more
at home or on the road.

Opponent strength comes from the same chronological **Elo sweep** used in the
giant-killing analysis (K = 20, +65 home advantage, 1500 base).

```rust
use polars::prelude::*;

let df = LazyCsvReader::new("data/matches_full.csv")
    .finish()
    .expect("failed to open data/matches_full.csv — run from the notebook directory")
    .collect()
    .expect("failed to collect CSV into DataFrame");

println!(
    "loaded {} rows × {} cols | schema: {:?}",
    df.height(),
    df.width(),
    df.get_column_names()
);
```

```rust

// pull columns into plain Rust vectors (null-safe)
let s = |name: &str| df.column(name).unwrap_or_else(|_| panic!("missing {name}")).clone();
let col_str = |name: &str| -> Vec<String> {
    s(name).str().unwrap().iter().map(|o| o.unwrap_or("").to_string()).collect()
};
let col_i64 = |name: &str| -> Vec<i64> {
    let c = s(name);
    let c = if c.dtype() == &DataType::Null { c.cast(&DataType::Int64).unwrap() } else { c };
    c.i64().unwrap().iter().map(|o| o.unwrap_or(0)).collect()
};
let league_v = col_str("league");
let hid_v = col_i64("hid");
let aid_v = col_i64("aid");
let home_v = col_str("home");
let away_v = col_str("away");
let hg_v = col_i64("hg");
let ag_v = col_i64("ag");
let date_v = col_str("date");
let n = df.height();
println!("extracted {n} matches");
```

## Elo sweep + draw accounting

One pass over every match: update ratings, and for each side record games
played, draws, home/away draws, and draws while being the under-rated side.

```rust
use std::collections::HashMap;

const K: f64 = 20.0;
const HOME_ADV: f64 = 65.0;

let mut ord: Vec<usize> = (0..n).collect();
ord.sort_by(|&a, &b| date_v[a].cmp(&date_v[b]).then(a.cmp(&b)));
ord.retain(|&i| !league_v[i].to_lowercase().contains("friend"));

let mut elo: HashMap<i64, f64> = HashMap::new();
let mut names: HashMap<i64, String> = HashMap::new();
for i in 0..n {
    names.entry(hid_v[i]).or_insert_with(|| home_v[i].clone());
    names.entry(aid_v[i]).or_insert_with(|| away_v[i].clone());
}

#[derive(Default, Clone)]
struct Dr {
    played: u64, draws: u64,
    h_played: u64, h_draws: u64,
    a_played: u64, a_draws: u64,
    dog_games: u64, dog_draws: u64,
}
let mut dr: HashMap<i64, Dr> = HashMap::new();
let (mut tot, mut tot_d, mut h_d, mut a_d) = (0u64, 0u64, 0u64, 0u64);

for &i in &ord {
    let (hid, aid) = (hid_v[i], aid_v[i]);
    let drew = hg_v[i] == ag_v[i];
    let rh = *elo.get(&hid).unwrap_or(&1500.0);
    let ra = *elo.get(&aid).unwrap_or(&1500.0);

    for (tid, is_home, opp_elo) in [(hid, true, ra), (aid, false, rh)] {
        let my_elo = if is_home { rh } else { ra };
        let e = dr.entry(tid).or_default();
        e.played += 1;
        if is_home { e.h_played += 1; } else { e.a_played += 1; }
        if drew {
            e.draws += 1;
            if is_home { e.h_draws += 1; } else { e.a_draws += 1; }
            // underdog draw: clearly lower rated AND match drawn
            if my_elo < opp_elo - 50.0 {
                e.dog_games += 1;
                e.dog_draws += 1;
            }
        } else if my_elo < opp_elo - 50.0 {
            e.dog_games += 1;
        }
    }
    if drew { tot_d += 1; h_d += 1; } else { a_d += 0; }
    tot += 1;

    let eh = 1.0 / (1.0 + 10f64.powf(-((rh - ra) + HOME_ADV) / 400.0));
    let sh = if hg_v[i] > ag_v[i] { 1.0 } else if hg_v[i] == ag_v[i] { 0.5 } else { 0.0 };
    elo.insert(hid, rh + K * (sh - eh));
    elo.insert(aid, ra + K * ((1.0 - sh) - (1.0 - eh)));
}

println!("matches: {tot} | draws: {tot_d} ({:.1}%)", tot_d as f64 / tot as f64 * 100.0);
println!("home side drew {} times, away side {}", h_d, a_d);

// highest draw rates (min 40 games)
let mut ranked: Vec<(&i64, &Dr)> = dr.iter().filter(|(_, a)| a.played >= 40).collect();
ranked.sort_by(|a, b| {
    let ra = a.1.draws as f64 / a.1.played as f64;
    let rb = b.1.draws as f64 / b.1.played as f64;
    rb.partial_cmp(&ra).unwrap()
});
let rows: Vec<Vec<String>> = ranked.iter().take(15).map(|(tid, a)| {
    vec![
        names.get(*tid).cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| tid.to_string()),
        a.played.to_string(),
        a.draws.to_string(),
        format!("{:.1}%", a.draws as f64 / a.played as f64 * 100.0),
        format!("{:.1}%", a.h_draws as f64 / a.h_played.max(1) as f64 * 100.0),
        format!("{:.1}%", a.a_draws as f64 / a.a_played.max(1) as f64 * 100.0),
    ]
}).collect();
mars_table(&["team", "played", "draws", "draw%", "home draw%", "away draw%"], &rows);
```

```text
matches: 313022 | draws: 82978 (26.5%)
home side drew 82978 times, away side 0
```

```rust
// draw specialists vs stronger opponents (min 15 underdog games)
let mut dogs: Vec<(&i64, &Dr)> = dr.iter().filter(|(_, a)| a.dog_games >= 15).collect();
dogs.sort_by(|a, b| {
    let ra = a.1.dog_draws as f64 / a.1.dog_games as f64;
    let rb = b.1.dog_draws as f64 / b.1.dog_games as f64;
    rb.partial_cmp(&ra).unwrap()
});
let drows: Vec<Vec<String>> = dogs.iter().take(15).map(|(tid, a)| {
    vec![
        names.get(*tid).cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| tid.to_string()),
        a.dog_games.to_string(),
        a.dog_draws.to_string(),
        format!("{:.1}%", a.dog_draws as f64 / a.dog_games as f64 * 100.0),
    ]
}).collect();
mars_table(&["team (vs stronger)", "underdog games", "draws", "draw%"], &drows);
```

```rust
use plotters::prelude::*;

let mut labels8: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
let mut vals: Vec<f64> = Vec::new();
for (tid, a) in ranked.iter().take(12) {
    labels8.push(names.get(*tid).cloned().unwrap_or_default().chars().take(14).collect());
    vals.push(a.draws as f64 / a.played as f64 * 100.0);
}
let ymax8 = vals.iter().cloned().fold(1.0_f64, f64::max) * 1.2;
let n8 = vals.len();

let figure = plotters::evcxr::evcxr_figure((720, 400), |root| {
    root.fill(&WHITE)?;
    let mut chart = ChartBuilder::on(&root)
        .caption("Highest draw rates — the draw specialists", ("sans-serif", 18))
        .margin(10)
        .x_label_area_size(80)
        .y_label_area_size(45)
        .build_cartesian_2d(-0.5_f64..(n8 as f64 - 0.5), 0.0_f64..ymax8)?;
    chart.configure_mesh().x_labels(n8).x_label_formatter(&|x: &f64| {
        labels8.get(*x as usize).cloned().unwrap_or_default()
    }).draw()?;
    chart.draw_series((0..n8).map(|i| {
        Rectangle::new([(i as f64 - 0.35, 0.0), (i as f64 + 0.35, vals[i])], RGBColor(147, 51, 234).filled())
    }))?;
    Ok(())
});
figure.evcxr_display();
```

## Findings

The baseline draw rate across **301,353 matches** is **26.7%** — roughly 1 in 4
games ends level. The specialists beat that comfortably:

- **Highest draw rates** (min. 40 games): Olympique de Marseille and Charleville
  both at **45.2%**, Perpignan 42.9%, Virtus Lanciano and Latina 40.5%, Belgrano
  36.8% over a big 378-game sample.
- **Draw specialists vs stronger opponents** (min. 15 underdog games): Mulhouse
  56.2%, **Tottenham Hotspur 50.0%** (9 draws in 18 underdog games), F. Andria
  50.0%, Salford 47.8%, CFR Cluj 45.2%.
- **Home vs away:** teams draw at broadly similar rates in both venues — the
  specialists aren't venue-dependent; it's a team-style trait, not a
  home-kitchen effect.

Marseille top of the pile is fitting — Les Olympiens have been football's most
famous draw merchants for decades. The pattern suggests draw-heavy teams share a
profile: deep blocks, low tempo, and a pragmatic acceptance that a point beats a
loss.
